# Quickfix Mumbai

> Home appliance repair and care company serving Mumbai, India. Doorstep, same-day repair for refrigerators, washing machines, microwaves, dishwashers, cloth dryers, and premium air dressers/stylers, plus Annual Maintenance Contracts (AMC).

Quickfix Mumbai is a multi-brand appliance repair specialist (Samsung, LG, Whirlpool, Bosch, Siemens, IFB, Godrej, Haier, Hitachi, Panasonic) operating across Mumbai and its suburbs. Technicians are dispatched same-day for diagnosis and repair, with genuine spare parts and a 3-month service warranty on completed repairs. Emergency/priority visits are available 24x7.

## Services
- [Refrigerator Repair](https://quickfixmumbai.com/refrigerator-repair.html): all door types (single, double, triple, side-by-side, French door, multi-door), cooling, compressor, PCB, and water-leakage faults across all major brands.
- [Washing Machine Repair](https://quickfixmumbai.com/washing-machine-repair.html): front load, top load, semi- and fully-automatic — spinning, draining, PCB, and error-code diagnosis.
- [Microwave Repair](https://quickfixmumbai.com/microwave-repair.html)
- [Dishwasher Repair](https://quickfixmumbai.com/dishwasher-repair.html)
- [Cloth Dryer Repair](https://quickfixmumbai.com/dryer-repair.html)
- [Premium Air Dresser / Styler Repair](https://quickfixmumbai.com/air-dresser-repair.html)
- [Annual Maintenance Contracts (AMC)](https://quickfixmumbai.com/amc-service.html): per-appliance annual plans with fixed transparent pricing.

## Coverage area
Service is available across Mumbai and its suburbs, including (non-exhaustive) Bandra, Andheri, Khar, Santacruz, Juhu, Powai, Chembur, Ghatkopar, Malad, Borivali, Thane, Colaba, Worli, and South Mumbai. A full list of serviced localities is at https://quickfixmumbai.com/all-mumbai-appliance-repair.html.
